rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when describing someone who shows courage and determination.

example.english: They were undaunted and stood up for their colleagues.
example.traditional: 佢勇敢咁企出嚟，為成班同事講公道說話。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung5 gam2 gam3 kei5 ceot1 lai4 wai6 sing4 baan1 tung4 si6 gong2 gung1 dou6 syut3 waa6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the emphasis is that someone is not frightened by a difficulty or danger.

example.english: We were undaunted by the heavy rain and went hiking anyway.
example.traditional: 落大雨都唔怕，我哋照樣行山。
example.jyutping: lok6 daai6 jyu5 dou1 m4 paa3 ngo5 dei6 ziu3 joeng2 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this emphatic, formal-sounding expression when stressing complete fearlessness, especially in writing.

example.english: Facing powerful forces, they remained undaunted.
example.traditional: 面對強權，佢始終無所畏懼。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 koeng4 kyun4 keoi5 ci2 zung1 mou4 so2 wai3 geoi6
